summary: Automation dashboard prerequisites: RHEL 9 or 10 (x86 or ARM) on a host separate from AAP, optional external PostgreSQL 15, tested at 80 GB disk, 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, 3000 IOPS (10,000 jobs/month, up to three same-version AAP deployments), a sudo non-root user, an AAP OAuth2 token, HTTPS 443 to AAP and ingress port 8447.
questions: What are the system requirements for automation dashboard?
Can I install automation dashboard on the AAP host?
What port does automation dashboard use?
How many AAP deployments can automation dashboard connect to?

answer_card.title: Automation dashboard requirements
answer_card.answer_md:
- RHEL 9 or RHEL 10, x86 or ARM; **not** on an AAP host. External DB option: PostgreSQL 15.
- Tested size: 80 GB disk, 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, 3000 IOPS; up to 10,000 jobs/month and three AAP deployments of the same version.
- Non-root user with sudo, `ansible-core`, baseos and AAP repos.
- AAP OAuth2 token; HTTPS 443 from dashboard to AAP; dashboard ingress port **8447** (configurable); allow 5432 for PostgreSQL.
